stem: Two technicians inspect the same flowering crop and reach different harvest recommendations. Which record would best support an auditable review of why their conclusions differed?
choices: Record each final recommendation and technician role because the decision outcome is sufficient to compare professional judgment
Record the cultivar's expected flowering duration and inspection date because schedule context is sufficient to reconstruct maturity reasoning
Record dated observations, sampled floral tissues and canopy positions, maturity indicators, plant condition, and the decision criteria used
Save one representative close-up from each technician after the decision and omit sampling position when both inspected the same room
rationale: An auditable maturity decision requires enough context to reconstruct the evidence and reasoning. Dated, representative observations with sampling context and explicit decision criteria are stronger than conclusions recorded without supporting evidence.
